name: CalendarYearBin
note: CheckCalendarDate: BIOS_YEAR in binary

name: CalendarMonthWeekday
note: CheckCalendarDate: month x 16 + weekday (computed from YearWeekdayTable), the byte SetupCalendar sends to the chip

name: CalendarDayBin
note: CheckCalendarDate: BIOS_DAY in binary

name: CardSavedSp
note: Card and CardError: stack pointer at entry, for the exits of the CARD functions

name: CardDirectory
note: address of the card directory (CardLayoutByte/Word)

name: CardDirEntries
note: number of directory entries - 1

name: CardFat
note: address of the first FAT copy (the second follows at +CardFatSize)

name: CardFatSize
note: size of one FAT copy in card bytes

name: CardDataStart
note: address of the first data block

name: CardType
note: CardDetect: 0 8-bit card, 1 16-bit card, $80 16-bit card on every other word; IsSnkRomCard writes the ROM card's value

name: CardTypeLo
note: low byte of CardType, tested by the CARD functions (0, positive, negative)

name: CardSize
note: card size from CardDetect (0 = none), written into the card header by CardFormat

name: CardSavedColour1
note: CardErrorSaveScreen: colours $400002-$400005 saved while a message is shown

name: CardSavedColour2
note: CardErrorSaveScreen: colours $400022-$400025 saved while a message is shown

note: debug monitor: d0-d7/a0-a6 saved at the exception (movem), 15 longs

name: MonitorRegsD4
note: debug monitor: the saved d4 (second half of the register dump)

name: MonitorSavedSsp
note: debug monitor: supervisor stack pointer after the exception frame

name: MonitorSavedUsp
note: debug monitor: user stack pointer (move usp)

name: MonitorSavedPc
note: debug monitor: PC from the exception frame

name: MonitorSavedSr
note: debug monitor: SR from the exception frame; TRACE sets bit 15 (bit 7 of this byte)

name: MonitorFrameWord
note: debug monitor: cleared when the monitor starts; nothing reads it

name: MonitorCause
note: debug monitor: exception code 0-$1C (4 per entry), indexes MonitorCauseTexts

name: MonitorSavedColour
note: debug monitor: colours $4001E2-$4001E5 saved while it runs

name: MonitorMemAddress
note: DISPLAY MEMORY: address shown (long)

name: MonitorMemAddressBytes
note: the 3 address bytes of MonitorMemAddress, printed by MonitorPutAddress

name: MonitorVramAddress
note: DISPLAY V-RAM: address shown (long)

name: MonitorVramAddressBytes
note: the 3 address bytes of MonitorVramAddress

name: MonitorVramAddressWord
note: low word of MonitorVramAddress, the VRAM address read

name: MonitorEditAddress
note: MODIFY MEMORY: address (long)

name: MonitorEditAddressBytes
note: the 3 address bytes of MonitorEditAddress

name: MonitorEditVram
note: MODIFY V-RAM: VRAM address (long, kept in $0000-$7400 and $8000-$857F)

name: MonitorEditVramBytes
note: the 3 address bytes of MonitorEditVram

name: MonitorEditVramWord
note: low word of MonitorEditVram, written to REG_VRAMADDR

name: MonitorRegisterIndex
note: MODIFY REGISTER: register picked (0-$12: d0-a7, SR, PC)

name: MonitorValue
note: value being edited (word for memory and VRAM, long for a register)

name: MonitorCommand
note: command number 0-6 (DISPLAY MEMORY .. RUN), A picks the next

name: MonitorDigit
note: digit under the cursor (word)

name: MonitorDigitLo
note: low byte of MonitorDigit, set from the digit tables

name: MonitorFrames
note: frame counter of MonitorLoop

name: MonitorFramesLo
note: low byte of MonitorFrames: bit 4 blinks the digit cursor

name: ErrorAddress
note: BootError: address of the failing word (a0), printed on the error screen

name: ErrorWritten
note: BootError: word written (d0)

name: ErrorRead
note: BootError: word read back (d1)

name: ErrorNumber
note: BootError: error number d6 (0-8)

name: NewDateFlag
note: PowerOnSetup: 1 when the calendar date differs from LastBootDate (a new day), then BookNewDayPerGame runs

name: LedSlotDisplay
note: MvsLedUpdate: slot number shown on the slot LED, cycling through the slots every 4 frames (cleared at boot)

name: CardStillInsertedTimer
note: CardStillInserted: 256-frame countdown

name: IoCheckSlotCount
note: I/O check: number of slots, for IoCheckNextSlotLed

name: IoCheckLedCount
note: I/O check: LED test count (00, 11 .. 99, BCD)

name: SoundTestCursor
note: sound test: item under the cursor

name: SoundTestCursorNew
note: sound test: item the cursor moves to

name: SoundTestPlaying
note: sound test: item playing (0 = SOUND OFF)

note: 36 words copied to SCB4 (sprite X positions) at $8401 by the MESS_OUT list EyecatchSpriteInit

name: EyecatchXPos2
note: second half of EyecatchXPos (sprites 19-36)

name: EyecatchYPos
note: 36 words copied to SCB3 (Y position, sticky bit, size) at $8201

name: EyecatchYPos2
note: second half of EyecatchYPos

name: EyecatchShrink
note: 36 words copied to SCB2 (shrink) at $8001

name: EyecatchShrinkV
note: vertical shrink byte of the first EyecatchShrink word, reduced by $10 per step

name: EyecatchShrink2
note: second half of EyecatchShrink

name: EyecatchShrink2V
note: vertical shrink byte of the second half

name: EyecatchTimer
note: frame counter / countdown of the current eyecatcher step

name: EyecatchCharCount
note: characters of MAX 330 MEGA / PRO-GEAR SPEC drawn so far (32 in all)

name: EyecatchCharAddress
note: fix address of the next character ($71B0, then $7192 for the second line)

name: EyecatchCharPointer
note: next character in EyecatchTextTiles

name: EyecatchColoursPending
note: 1 when EyecatchSetColours has queued a colour set for the next VBlank

name: EyecatchColoursPointer
note: colour set queued by EyecatchSetColours

name: HowToPlayPointer
note: HowToPlay: position in the animation data that follows HowToPlayPalettes

name: HowToPlayTimer
note: HowToPlay: frames left before the next animation entry

name: CodeNumberDigit
note: SETTING UP THE CODE NUMBER: digit under the cursor

name: HardDipLast
note: SETTING UP THE HARD DIP: REG_DIPSW value last drawn (redraw when it changes)

note: game list (soft DIP and book keeping): line under the cursor (0 = the cabinet line)

name: ListCursorNew
note: game list: line the cursor moves to

name: ListGameCount
note: game list: number of games (slots with a cartridge)

name: ListLineCount
note: game list: number of lines (games + 1)

name: CabinetOldRow
note: CabinetSettingsOld: row under the cursor

name: CabinetOldRowNew
note: CabinetSettingsOld: row the cursor moves to

name: CabinetOldDrawFlags
note: CabinetSettingsOld: 2 while all rows are drawn; bit 0 toggled for the blinking value

name: SoftDipDefinition
note: SoftDipEditor: copy of the game's soft DIP block (cartridge header pointer for this region): settings, then the 12-byte texts

name: SoftDipRows
note: SoftDipEditor: per screen row, the setting type and its byte in BIOS_GAME_DIP (2 words)

name: SoftDipGameLine
note: the game list line chosen (ListCursor), read on entry

name: SoftDipRow
note: SoftDipEditor: row under the cursor

name: SoftDipRowNew
note: SoftDipEditor: row the cursor moves to

name: SoftDipGameEntry
note: SoftDipEditor: the game's entry in the game list (slot, index, name)

name: SoftDipRowCount
note: SoftDipEditor: number of settings of the game

name: SoftDipFirstRow
note: SoftDipEditor: first setting shown (8 per page)

name: SoftDipTimeColumn
note: SoftDipEditor: column of a time setting being edited (word, cleared on entry)

name: SoftDipTimeColumnLo
note: low byte of SoftDipTimeColumn: Left/Right toggle bit 0 (minutes / seconds)

name: BookRecords
note: book keeping: copy of the records shown (36 days then 12 months, BookCopyDays/BookCopyMonths)

name: BookListCursor
note: book keeping list: line under the cursor (0 CABINET/COIN, 1 CABINET/PLAY, then the games)

name: BookListCursorNew
note: book keeping list: line the cursor moves to

name: BookListGameCount
note: book keeping list: number of games

name: BookListLineCount
note: book keeping list: number of lines

name: BookPage
note: book keeping pages: page shown (0 daily, then months)

name: BookGameEntry
note: BookGame: the game's name in the game list

name: CabinetRow
note: SETTING UP THE CABINET: row under the cursor (5 rows)

name: CabinetRowNew
note: SETTING UP THE CABINET: row the cursor moves to

name: CabinetDrawFlags
note: SETTING UP THE CABINET: 2 while all rows are drawn; bit 0 toggled for the blinking value

name: CardUtilMenuNew
note: card utility menu: line the cursor moves to (WorkIndex holds the current one)

name: DataListLast
note: data lists (CardErrorFull, card utility): index of the last title

name: DataListPageFirst
note: data lists: index of the first title on the page

name: DataListLine
note: data lists: line on the page (0-5), also the line counter of a page drawing

name: DataListCursor
note: data lists: title under the cursor (drawn)

name: DataListCursorNew
note: data lists: title the cursor moves to

name: CopyAllPtr
note: card utility COPY: pointer into the title table kept across the card swap

name: CopyAllResult
note: card utility COPY: CARD result kept across the card swap

name: NameColumn
note: FILE USER'S NAME: column of the character cursor (drawn)

name: NameColumnNew
note: FILE USER'S NAME: column the character cursor moves to

name: NameKey
note: FILE USER'S NAME: key under the keyboard cursor (drawn)

name: NameKeyNew
note: FILE USER'S NAME: key the keyboard cursor moves to

name: NameKeyNewLo
note: low byte of NameKeyNew (CardUtilDirectionIndex writes the next key)

name: NameKeyMode
note: FILE USER'S NAME: 0, 1 or 2, set by two of the special keys (CardUtilNameKeyHandlers); meaning not found

note: PowerOnSetup and ScanSlots: CART_NGH of each slot, 4 bytes per slot

note: cleared at the end of HowToPlay; nothing else uses it
